proposal.reason: Primary change is review-routing behavior, owned by workflow: .github/workflows/review-routing.yml changes PR-number handoff to use classify output (`fromJSON(...).pr_number`), and .github/scripts/review_automation.py updates invitation sync to treat DELETE-withdrawal HTTP 422 as warning while continuing routing/summary generation. Supporting API diagnostic handling in .github/scripts/reviewer_api.py (sanitized/truncated GitHub error details) and docs in .github/WORKFLOWS.md are part of the same reviewer-assignment/approval automation path, not an independent module scope.
